## Summary

OIDC provenance signing is working (attestation published to sigstore), but the npm registry still requires an npm automation token to authenticate the actual publish. Adds `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}` to the publish step in both `release.yml` and `auto-release.yml`.

After merge: dispatching `release.yml` on tag `v0.4.2` to publish the pending release.
